name: Livestorm
description: Livestorm is a browser-based event platform for webinars, virtual meetings, on-demand events, registration, engagement, recordings, analytics, and integrations.
agentUseSummary: Connect a validated Livestorm workspace through Relay-owned Technology Partner OAuth with only identity and event read scopes, then inspect one fixed first page of content-free event lifecycle metadata.

capabilities.label: Read event lifecycle
capabilities.description: Inspect one bounded first page of content-free Livestorm event lifecycle metadata.

approvalRequired.label: List event lifecycle
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded first page of content-free event lifecycle metadata for the connected Livestorm workspace.

blocked.label: Identity and event content
blocked.description: Event, session, organization, owner, and people IDs plus titles, descriptions, slugs, registration and room links, form fields, tags, and raw records are not returned.

blocked.label: People and engagement
blocked.description: Registrants, attendees, hosts, moderators, guest speakers, contact details, answers, chat, questions, polls, votes, surveys, attendance, and engagement are not exposed.

blocked.label: Media and communications
blocked.description: Recordings, replay URLs, transcripts, audio, livestreams, emails, invitations, reminders, webhooks, and communications are not exposed.

blocked.label: Changes and raw API
blocked.description: Event and session creation, updates, publication, cancellation, registration, people, media, webhook, and every other mutation plus arbitrary paths, filters, includes, pages, origins, bodies, and tokens are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every connected-workspace event lifecycle read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected lifecycle reads run without Relay per-action approval while connected-workspace binding, fixed origins and endpoints, first-page bounds, redaction, audits, exact OAuth scopes, workspace validation, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware content-free Livestorm event lifecycle tool and refreshes the workspace grant server-side.
Railway mounts one approval-aware content-free Livestorm event lifecycle tool and refreshes the workspace grant server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Livestorm OAuth is restricted to official Technology Partners. Relay must be approved, register an exact two-scope client and Railway callback, configure encrypted credentials, and authorize a validated Livestorm workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: Complete Technology Partner review, register the exact-scope PKCE client and Railway callback, configure encrypted credentials, authorize a representative validated workspace, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous reads, verify refresh and local disconnect, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Livestorm documents partner-only confidential OAuth, optional PKCE, two-hour access tokens, refresh tokens, Bearer authentication, five requests per second, and exact identity:read and events:read scopes.
Livestorm documents the OAuth-only GET /v1/me endpoint used to bind each read to the connected user and workspace.
Livestorm documents GET /v1/events, page number and size controls, lifecycle status values, timestamps, and optional content-bearing filters/includes that Relay does not expose.
Livestorm documents the default 10,000-call rolling monthly quota, five-request-per-second burst limit, 429 behavior, and rate-limit response headers.
